title: Musher Listing Document
description: A listing document: how one catalog item is presented, categorised and found in the storefront.
$comment: Structural validation only. Item-root agreement, Markdown, media on disk and the admission rules (media dimensions, SPDX membership) are later validation phases. See spec.md §6.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Must be LISTING.

specVersion.description: Major version of the Musher document format.

ListingMetadata.description: Identity block of a listing document. A listing names the catalog item it presents and carries no revision of its own. See spec.md §3.

slug.description: Item slug, in the DNS-label grammar. Must equal the item directory name.

ListingScreenshot.description: One screenshot in the storefront gallery, declared as a media path.

caption.description: Accessible caption shown beneath the screenshot. Omitted when none.

file.$comment: Lookahead-free so it compiles under RE2 as well as ECMA-262. A segment must begin with a letter or digit, which is how `.` and `..` are excluded without a negative lookahead; the extension alternation is spelled in character classes because a JSON Schema pattern carries no case-insensitive flag. See spec.md §5.
file.description: Media path of the screenshot, relative to the item root and below media/: a .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp file. At most 5 MiB, and at most 4096 pixels per side (spec.md §5).

ListingSpec.description:
The `spec` block of a listing document: how the catalog item is presented,
categorised, and found in the storefront.

Identity lives in `metadata`, not here. `icon`, `screenshots[].file` and every
image in `overview` and `gettingStarted` are media paths, resolved inside the
item root and required to begin with `media/`.

category.$comment: spec.md §4.2 and docs/governance.md, Changing a controlled vocabulary. Adding a value is a minor release and removing one is a new major. spec.md §1.2 maps the v1 values v2 dropped (AI_ML, GAMING).
category.description: Storefront category the listing is browsed under. AGENTS: agents, agent gateways and orchestrators, and builders that assemble agents. AUTOMATION: workflow engines, schedulers and integration tools. COMMUNICATION: messaging, chat and email between people. DATABASES: relational, key-value, document, vector and search stores, and caches. DEVELOPER_TOOLS: editors, workspaces, source hosting, CI and other tools for writing software. INFRASTRUCTURE: building blocks no other category holds, such as message brokers, registries and runners. MEDIA: media servers, streaming, publishing and entertainment, games included. MODELS: reaching, serving and improving models, such as model gateways, inference servers, chat frontends over models, model registries, experiment tracking and training-data tools. NETWORKING: proxies, tunnels, VPNs and DNS. OBSERVABILITY: metrics, logs and traces, including the tracing and evaluation of model and agent calls. PRODUCTIVITY: documents, wikis, notes and project management. SECURITY: identity, single sign-on, secret stores and scanners. STORAGE: object storage, file storage and backups.

displayName.description: Title of the catalog item in the storefront.

gettingStarted.$comment: spec.md §4 and §4.1. The overview Markdown profile, its link and image rules and the media bounds are semantic rules, so the schema bounds only the length.
gettingStarted.description: What a person does right after a deployment of the item is running, as Markdown in the overview Markdown profile. May name a parameter by its ui.label; should never hold a parameter value or a credential. Omitted when none.

homepageURL.description: Project homepage URL. Omitted when none. Must use the https, http, or mailto scheme, in any case.
homepageURL.$comment: Anchored and lookahead-free, so it compiles under RE2 as well as ECMA-262 and cannot be driven to backtrack. The scheme set is spec.md §4.1's (LIST-URL-001), applied to a field that carries a URL directly rather than inside Markdown. The scheme alternation is spelled in character classes because a JSON Schema pattern carries no case-insensitive flag, and RFC 3986 §3.1 makes the scheme case-insensitive, the same reason the media path alternation is spelled that way. Without it this pattern would reject an upper-case scheme the overview half of the same rule accepts.

icon.description: Media path of the listing's icon (e.g. media/icon.png), relative to the item root. Square, at least 256 pixels per side, and at most 1 MiB (spec.md §5). Omitted for no icon.
icon.$comment: The same grammar ListingScreenshot.file carries; see the note there.

itemType.$comment: spec.md §3. BLUEPRINT if and only if the item root holds blueprint.yaml (LIST-ITEM-001), and a COMPONENT item holds exactly one component document (LIST-ITEM-002). Both are semantic rules, because they read the item root rather than the document.
itemType.description: Type of catalog item this listing presents: BLUEPRINT (a blueprint item: a blueprint and the components it deploys) or COMPONENT (a component item: one component published on its own).

license.$comment: spec.md §4 (LIST-LICENSE-001) and ADR 0003 §2. The shape is this specification's and the membership is SPDX's, published at https://spdx.org/licenses/ and deliberately not restated; membership is the admission rule LIST-LICENSE-002. A group of parentheses does not nest, which spec.md §9 records. Anchored and lookahead-free, so it compiles under RE2 as well as ECMA-262.
license.description: SPDX licence expression for the listed software, such as MIT, Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, or (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0. Omitted when unspecified.

lifecycleStage.description: Maturity stage shown in the storefront: EXPERIMENTAL, BETA and STABLE in increasing order, or SUNSET for an item that is going away.

overview.$comment: spec.md §4 and §4.1. The overview Markdown profile, its link and image rules and the media bounds are semantic rules, so the schema bounds only the length.
overview.description: What the item is and when to choose it, as Markdown in the overview Markdown profile: CommonMark 0.31.2 with no raw HTML, links on https, http or mailto, and images that are media paths. Omitted when none.

screenshots.description: Storefront gallery, in display order, declared as media paths. At most twelve.

sourceRepositoryURL.description: URL of the source repository. Omitted when none. Must use the https, http, or mailto scheme, in any case.
sourceRepositoryURL.$comment: The same grammar homepageURL carries; see the note there.

summary.description: One-line plain-text tagline, never rendered as Markdown.

supportURL.description: Support or documentation URL. Omitted when none. Must use the https, http, or mailto scheme, in any case.
supportURL.$comment: The same grammar homepageURL carries; see the note there. mailto: is in the set for this field in particular: a support address is a plausible value.

tags.description: Discovery tags the storefront groups listings by, in lowercase kebab-case. At most sixteen, and a tag may not repeat.

items.$comment: spec.md §4 (LIST-TAG-001) and ADR 0007 §4. A tag is lowercase kebab, so the grammar is what makes two spellings of one tag impossible rather than merely discouraged.
